protocol.name: SA-11 paper comparison v3: upper/lower coverage
protocol.reference: Jan, Experimental validation of ASWING, Part I, p.35 and Figure 22 p.39; numerical ASWING 5.96 curves authenticated by the existing paper/table audit
protocol.policy: All four configurations, both figure speeds, three lift and three matched-lift drag samples per curve. Use raw ASWING coefficients, with no experimental drag allowance. Never extrapolate, bridge rejected states, substitute a mesh point by point, or remove missing comparisons from the denominator. Mesh repeats, dimensional duplicates, CDi, Cm and efficiency remain separate regression evidence. This is a changed comparison scope, not new solver improvement or full SA-11 validation.

alignment_spec.name: SA-11 paper comparison v2: aligned frozen influences
alignment_spec.changes: Preserve all 48 Figure22 targets and the5% gate. Replace original baseline/extension current-wind curves by fixed cosine64 minimum-spacing frozen-influence curves over0..5.5degrees. Reuse four identical frozen extension states. Append the upper-winglet240m/s5.25degree state on its existing report-derived mesh/input. Retain all other upper/lower evidence and missing/rejected comparisons.
alignment_spec.qualification: Matching flight/influence settings does not make the original baseline and companion models a wingtip-only comparison: their main-wing dCLda,Cdf,Cdp andCLmax inputs differ. Report the actual differences and audit shared-section properties; do not silently replace any airfoil data.

surface_force_diagnostic.scope: Lifting-surface circulatory, circulation-rate and profile forces only.

vortex_breakdown.scope: Cached coefficients include PG and configured ground images; distances identify physical bound segments and rays, not images. Shared bound endpoints require exact coordinate equality; their turns describe geometry, not a separate flow estimate. Largest three nonzero terms of each kind; up to four source endpoints per wake group. Large terms can cancel and do not independently equal the local flow.

diagnostic.qualification: Rejected-state accounting only; no full saved-field replay or accepted force comparison.
